title: Corners are smushed
text: Corners are smushed. This book has great weight to it and I like the design overall. However, when I opened it, the corners are warped and the pages sound as if the glue holding them together is going to crack. Since it's just for our wedding guests to write it, it'll be fine but I expected the item to be in better shape.
